summary: Design payment triggers, verify outcomes, and strengthen programme controls. Explore practical results-based financing training and enrol your team.
lede: Results-based financing links programme payments to defined outputs or outcomes and requires clear evidence for each trigger. For donor programme managers, public finance officers and MEAL specialists, this training develops practical skills to build results frameworks, set indicators and disbursement triggers, and design verification protocols. Participants can also assess data quality, safeguards and contractual risks, then track evidence and payment decisions in an Excel disbursement tool.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who structure, fund, monitor, verify, or oversee results-linked programmes and payments.
modules: Results-Based Financing and Theory of Change
prerequisites: Working familiarity with programme monitoring, results frameworks, public finance, or contract management is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for the spreadsheet-based exercise; no specialist software installation is required.
